providerFields.inheritGuideSearch: Use the hotspot AI search model

auth_google_client_id.label: Google OAuth Client ID
auth_google_client_id.help: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Web Client ID.

auth_line_channel_id.label: LINE Login Channel ID
auth_line_channel_id.help: Apply for the OpenID Connect Email scope in LINE Developers.

auth_oauth_flow_ttl_seconds.label: Sign-in flow lifetime (seconds)
auth_oauth_flow_ttl_seconds.help: One-time state, nonce and PKCE values are kept for 10 minutes by default.

auth_oauth_ip_limit.label: Flow starts per IP per hour

ga4_enabled.label: Also send GA4 cookieless events
ga4_enabled.help: Sends scrubbed events only while every Consent Mode signal is denied, and stores no GA cookie on this site.

ga4_measurement_id.label: GA4 Measurement ID
ga4_measurement_id.help: Formatted G-...; a public identifier, not a Data API key.

adsense_publisher_id.label: Publisher ID
adsense_publisher_id.help: The ca-pub- plus 16 digits from AdSense. A public identifier: it is written into the article page itself.

adsense_slot_id.label: In-article ad unit slot ID
adsense_slot_id.help: The 10 digits of the in-article ad unit, found in AdSense under Ads → By ad unit: the data-ad-slot in that unit's code (or its ID column in the list). Not the customer ID on the Account → Account information page; that is 10 digits too, so this card still shows green while article pages show no ads. Article pages show a slot only once both IDs are valid.

adsense_cmp_enabled.label: Google consent message published
adsense_cmp_enabled.help: Tick this once a GDPR message is published under Privacy & messaging in AdSense (shown only in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland). While it is off, the site serves non-personalised ads only.

analytics_trust_country_header.label: Trust the proxy's country header
analytics_trust_country_header.help: Reads only the two-letter code the BFF forwards from a configured trusted proxy header; unknown when unset.

analytics_retention_days.label: Raw event retention (days)
analytics_retention_days.help: 90 days by default; the maintenance job deletes older rows.

registration_enabled.label: Open public registration
registration_enabled.help: When off, no new account (including the environment admin emails) can self-register; existing members still sign in.

access_token_expire_minutes.label: Session lifetime (minutes)
access_token_expire_minutes.help: How long a newly issued sign-in token lasts (5–1440). Takes effect on the next sign-in or renewal without a redeploy; existing tokens keep their own lifetime until their renewal point.

session_absolute_max_days.label: Absolute sign-in cap (days)
session_absolute_max_days.help: However often it renews, one sign-in lasts at most this many days (1–365) before a fresh sign-in is required.

google_maps_javascript_enabled.label: Enable the browser route map
google_maps_javascript_enabled.help: A safety gate. Turn it on only after confirming the Maps JavaScript API is enabled and the browser key is restricted to mokaair.com and www.mokaair.com; while off, transit plans and exact external navigation still work.

ai_planner_user_budget.label: AI planning attempts per account per window
ai_planner_user_budget.help: Every AI planning attempt an account makes inside the window counts, answered or not; the window is AI_PLANNER_USER_BUDGET_WINDOW_SECONDS (one hour by default) and the default is 40. Once spent, planning does not refuse: the itinerary comes from the reviewed catalogue with a planner_budget_reached note, and only /intents answers 429 planner_budget_reached. A lower number applies to the next request, no restart needed.

ai_planner_ip_budget.label: AI planning attempts per source address per window
ai_planner_ip_budget.help: The same count per source IP address (120 by default), so freshly minted accounts share one ceiling. Keep it well above the per-account number so a household, an office or a carrier NAT never meets it; reaching it falls back to the catalogue plan the same way, and /intents answers 429 planner_budget_reached.

hotspot_guide_ai_default_provider.label: Default vendor for hotspot AI search

hotspot_guide_ai_daily_call_budget.label: AI model calls per day
hotspot_guide_ai_daily_call_budget.help: Administrator searches cost members nothing but are counted against this budget and logged in the audit trail.

flight_provider_mode.label: Flight search source
flight_provider_mode.help: Hybrid mode keeps querying the next source until the itinerary count reaches the threshold; extra sources do not cost another search.

flight_min_result_count.label: Top-up threshold
flight_min_result_count.help: Query the next provider when fewer deduplicated itineraries than this remain.

hotel_provider_mode.label: Hotel search source
hotel_provider_mode.help: Automatic mode uses Amadeus until the Booking.com Demand API is approved.

provider_timeout_seconds.label: Provider timeout (seconds)
provider_timeout_seconds.help: Maximum wait for one external request.

naver_place_cache_ttl_seconds.label: NAVER place cache (seconds)
naver_place_cache_ttl_seconds.help: Place details are cached in Redis under an opaque id; 15 minutes by default.

naver_maps_monthly_request_limit.label: Monthly reminder quota
naver_maps_monthly_request_limit.help: An optional internal reminder threshold, not NAVER's free tier or a billing cap; 0 means unset.

weather_cache_ttl_seconds.label: Weather cache (seconds)
weather_cache_ttl_seconds.help: Google Weather is cached for 15 minutes by default to cut repeat queries.

google_maps_essentials_free_limit.label: Essentials free calls per SKU
google_maps_essentials_free_limit.help: Public pricing defaults to 10,000 per SKU per month; adjust here if your contract differs.

google_maps_pro_free_limit.label: Pro free calls per SKU
google_maps_pro_free_limit.help: Public pricing defaults to 5,000 per SKU per month.

google_maps_enterprise_free_limit.label: Enterprise free calls per SKU
google_maps_enterprise_free_limit.help: Public pricing defaults to 1,000 per SKU per month.

restaurant_scan_enabled.label: Scan restaurants around hotspots
restaurant_scan_enabled.help: When off, no Nearby, Aggregate or restaurant Details requests are sent.

restaurant_aggregate_monthly_budget.label: Restaurant Aggregate monthly cap
restaurant_aggregate_monthly_budget.help: 4,000 by default, keeping 20% of the public Places Aggregate free tier in reserve.

restaurant_nearby_monthly_budget.label: Restaurant Nearby monthly cap
restaurant_nearby_monthly_budget.help: 800 by default, used for live popular restaurants on the public site.

restaurant_details_monthly_budget.label: Restaurant Details monthly cap
restaurant_details_monthly_budget.help: 800 by default; shared with other Place Details calls and stopped before the free tier runs out.

restaurant_scan_batch_call_limit.label: Calls per restaurant scan batch
restaurant_scan_batch_call_limit.help: At most 50 every six hours by default; progress is kept and hotspots rotate.

restaurant_location_cache_days.label: Restaurant coordinate Redis TTL (days)
restaurant_location_cache_days.help: Only coordinates are cached; default and maximum are both 30 days, after which Redis drops them.

hotspot_guide_youtube_daily_search_budge.label: Automatic searches per day
hotspot_guide_youtube_daily_search_budge.help: 80 by default, leaving 20 of the daily Search Queries quota for administrators.

hotspot_guide_youtube_search_daily_free_.label: Search Queries daily quota
hotspot_guide_youtube_search_daily_free_.help: YouTube allows 100 search.list queries a day by default; adjust if your Cloud project has a different quota.

hotspot_guide_youtube_core_daily_free_li.label: Core API daily quota
hotspot_guide_youtube_core_daily_free_li.help: YouTube allows 10,000 units a day by default; each videos.list request currently costs 1 unit.

hotspot_guide_gemini_base_url.label: Gemini API Base URL
hotspot_guide_gemini_base_url.help: Only Google's official generativelanguage domains are accepted.

hotspot_guide_backfill_enabled.label: Backfill hotspots without a guide
hotspot_guide_backfill_enabled.help: Each background round picks hotspots with no video or article yet and searches for them, map-verified ones first. When off, only administrators search by hand.

hotspot_guide_backfill_batch_size.label: Hotspots per round
hotspot_guide_backfill_batch_size.help: The most hotspots one round handles. The actual number is still bounded by each search provider's daily quota; when it runs out the round stops there.

hotspot_guide_backfill_locale.label: Backfill locales
hotspot_guide_backfill_locale.help: A comma-separated list processed in order, e.g. zh-TW,ja,ko,en,zh-CN. Every hotspot gets something in the first locale before the second starts; each hotspot searches one locale per round, so listing five locales does not multiply the quota by five. A hotspot searched without result is not retried in that locale for 30 days.

navitime_api_base_url.label: API Base URL
navitime_api_base_url.help: For RapidAPI use https://navitime-route-totalnavi.p.rapidapi.com; for a direct contract use the gateway host NAVITIME provides (navitime.co.jp / navitime.biz).

navitime_monthly_request_limit.label: Monthly request cap
navitime_monthly_request_limit.help: NAVITIME requests sent by this site, counted per month in Japan time; at the cap calls stop and a Google Maps link is shown instead. 450 by default, leaving room under RapidAPI Basic's 500 for admin tests; 0 counts without limiting.

ekispert_api_base_url.label: API Base URL
ekispert_api_base_url.help: Fixed to Ekispert's official https://api.ekispert.jp; third-party relay hosts are refused.

ekispert_search_type.label: Route data mode
ekispert_search_type.help: plain does not mean a dated timetable; pick departure only once the contract is confirmed to include timetable search.

ekispert_monthly_request_limit.label: Monthly request cap
ekispert_monthly_request_limit.help: At the cap external calls stop and exact Google Maps navigation is offered instead; 450 by default, 0 counts without limiting.

odsay_language.label: Route data language
odsay_language.help: The ODsay Standard plan only serves Korean; pick another language only if the contract includes multilingual service.

odsay_daily_request_limit.label: Daily request cap
odsay_daily_request_limit.help: The Basic plan allows 30 a day; the site uses 25 by default and keeps 5 for tests. Adjust to your commercial contract; 0 counts without limiting.

travelpayouts_static_url_template.label: Fallback partner link
travelpayouts_static_url_template.help: Used only when the Partner Links API fails; may contain '{destination}', '{departure_date}', '{return_date}' and '{sub_id}'.

travelpayouts_connectivity_target_url.label: eSIM target URL
travelpayouts_connectivity_target_url.help: Falls back to the activities target URL when empty.

travelpayouts_allowed_hosts.label: Allowed redirect hosts
travelpayouts_allowed_hosts.help: Comma-separated; only HTTPS URLs on these hosts are allowed.

trip_com_affiliate_url_template.label: Full partner link generated in the partner console
trip_com_affiliate_url_template.help: Existing Trip.com tracking parameters are never overwritten.

booking_demand_env.label: Demand API environment
booking_demand_env.help: After switching to production, save and run the connection test again.

booking_demand_api_base_url.label: Demand API v3.1 Base URL
booking_demand_api_base_url.help: Only Booking.com's official sandbox or production domains are accepted.

booking_demand_affiliate_id.label: Demand API Affiliate ID
booking_demand_affiliate_id.help: Stored separately from the affiliate redirect ID; the Affiliate section's ID is used only when this is empty.

booking_booker_country.label: Booker country code
booking_booker_country.help: Two-letter lowercase country code; Taiwan uses tw.

openai_model.label: OpenAI model
openai_model.help: Model used when trip planning calls OpenAI. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

anthropic_model.label: Claude model
anthropic_model.help: Model used when trip planning calls Claude. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

minimax_model.label: MiniMax model
minimax_model.help: Model used when trip planning calls MiniMax. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

gemini_model.label: Gemini model
gemini_model.help: Model used when trip planning or trip text parsing calls Gemini. Pick “Custom…” to enter an unlisted ID.

hotspot_guide_ai_openai_model.label: OpenAI model
hotspot_guide_ai_openai_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner OpenAI model.

hotspot_guide_ai_anthropic_model.label: Claude model
hotspot_guide_ai_anthropic_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner Claude model.

hotspot_guide_ai_minimax_model.label: MiniMax model
hotspot_guide_ai_minimax_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner MiniMax model.

hotspot_guide_ai_gemini_model.label: Gemini model
hotspot_guide_ai_gemini_model.help: Only affects hotspot guide search. Leave empty to reuse the trip planner Gemini model.

hotspot_intro_ai_default_provider.label: Default vendor for introduction writing
hotspot_intro_ai_default_provider.help: Keys come from the AI vendors card; drafts always land for review.

hotspot_intro_ai_daily_run_limit.label: Introduction runs per day
hotspot_intro_ai_daily_run_limit.help: One run writes every requested language for one attraction in a single call.

hotspot_intro_ai_daily_call_budget.label: Introduction model calls per day
hotspot_intro_ai_daily_call_budget.help: A call is charged before the request goes out, because a crash halfway through still cost the vendor.

hotspot_intro_ai_openai_model.label: OpenAI model
hotspot_intro_ai_openai_model.help: Only affects introduction writing. Leave empty to reuse the hotspot AI search OpenAI model.

hotspot_intro_ai_anthropic_model.label: Claude model
hotspot_intro_ai_anthropic_model.help: Only affects introduction writing. Leave empty to reuse the hotspot AI search Claude model.

hotspot_intro_ai_minimax_model.label: MiniMax model
hotspot_intro_ai_minimax_model.help: Only affects introduction writing. Leave empty to reuse the hotspot AI search MiniMax model.

hotspot_intro_ai_gemini_model.label: Gemini model
hotspot_intro_ai_gemini_model.help: Only affects introduction writing. Leave empty to reuse the hotspot AI search Gemini model.

hotspot_guide_gemini_model.label: Gemini model
hotspot_guide_gemini_model.help: Flash-tier models build hotspot candidate lists well but are weaker at listing grounded article sources; Pro-tier models may be unavailable to new API keys, so rely on the connection test.

azure_speech_region.label: Region
azure_speech_region.help: The Azure region code chosen when the Speech resource was created, e.g. eastasia. The key and the region must come from the same resource.

azure_speech_voices.label: Allowed voices
azure_speech_voices.help: Voices the video tool may use, comma-separated. Taiwan Mandarin: zh-TW-HsiaoChenNeural, zh-TW-YunJheNeural, zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural; multilingual voices are switched to Taiwan Mandarin automatically.

azure_speech_monthly_character_limit.label: Monthly billable-character limit
azure_speech_monthly_character_limit.help: Counted per UTC month; a Chinese character counts twice and SSML markup counts too. The default 450,000 stays under the free tier's 500,000; 0 counts without limiting.

azure_speech_timeout_seconds.label: Synthesis timeout (seconds)
azure_speech_timeout_seconds.help: How long the server waits for Azure to return one stretch of narration.

video_speech_gemini_monthly_character_li.label: Gemini narration monthly character limit
video_speech_gemini_monthly_character_li.help: When the channel voice is a Gemini voice (such as Sulafat), the most text characters sent per month, counted by UTC month; requests over it are refused before anything is sent. Default 300,000, about a hundred 10-minute videos; 0 counts without limiting.

jev_daily_call_budget.label: Jev calls per day
jev_daily_call_budget.help: Daily limit shared by the news automation, the Jev shadow assessment of place guides and the narration check, counted by UTC day; once spent, Jev is not called again that day. Default 200.

openai_connection.label: OpenAI connection
openai_connection.help: Choose subscription accounts to run OpenAI calls for guide search, place introductions, reviews, Simplified names and AI news through the signed-in Codex accounts on the host. Video stages can choose Codex separately. Trip planning and trip text parsing still need an API key. Only the owner can switch this.

anthropic_connection.label: Claude connection
anthropic_connection.help: With "Subscription accounts", the Claude calls of guide search, place introductions, introduction review, Simplified names and AI news run on the Claude subscription accounts signed in under AI accounts on the host, not on an API key. The accounts take turns in order, A, B, C and back to A: one is left only when its 5-hour or weekly window is full. When every account is full, calls wait for one to reset; they never switch to another vendor or model. The trip planner and trip text parsing still use the API key only. Only the owner can switch this.

packages.title: Public usage packs
packages.help: Active plans appear on the pricing page in display order. Payment is not included in this feature.
packages.archiveConfirm: Archive “{name}”? Historical ledgers will not be changed.

costs.title: Charges by feature
costs.help: Zero makes a feature free. New values do not change operations that have already started or completed.

travel_search.label: Standard trip search
travel_search.help: A standard flight, hotel, or activity search.

flexible_flight_search.label: Flexible-date flight search
flexible_flight_search.help: A flight search with flexible dates enabled.

full_trip_search.label: Full trip search
full_trip_search.help: Optimizes a trip across at least three modules.

multi_city_search.label: Multi-city search
multi_city_search.help: Searches a trip containing multiple flight legs.

back_to_back_fare_search.label: Public back-to-back comparison
back_to_back_fare_search.help: Compares two trips using public fares.

live_back_to_back_fare_search.label: Live back-to-back comparison
live_back_to_back_fare_search.help: Compares back-to-back fares through live providers.

flight_status_lookup.label: Flight status lookup
flight_status_lookup.help: Checks live flight status by number or route.

ai_itinerary_generation.label: AI itinerary planning
ai_itinerary_generation.help: Generates a day or complete itinerary with AI.

ai_itinerary_refine.label: AI itinerary refinement
ai_itinerary_refine.help: Re-plans a day or the whole trip from an intent typed by the traveller.

itinerary_optimization.label: Route optimization
itinerary_optimization.help: Applies optimized routing to an existing itinerary.

price_reoptimization.label: Trip repricing
price_reoptimization.help: Reprices and reoptimizes an existing trip.

audit.title: Recent admin history
audit.help: Records the operator, target, and before-and-after values.
audit.empty: No plan or charge changes have been recorded yet.

analytics.title: Traffic and product analytics
analytics.description: Understand traffic, acquisition, and the core product funnel using first-party data without exposing individual member activity.
analytics.loadError: Analytics data could not be loaded.
analytics.funnelRollup: Daily aggregate counts are used beyond raw-event retention.
analytics.authoritativeHelp: Calculated directly from member, search, trip, and affiliate tables and kept separate from browser event metrics.
analytics.heatmapHelp: Public page views shown in Asia/Taipei time.
analytics.heatmapUnavailable: Hourly data is unavailable for this range.

layout.title: Layout management
layout.description: Control which public features and pages are visible. Disabling one hides the Web interface only; it does not disable APIs or delete existing data.
layout.saveSuccess: Layout settings saved and the public state has been refreshed.
layout.auditDescription: Records only the operator, fields that actually changed, and the resulting values.

hotspots_enabled.label: Popular hotspots
hotspots_enabled.help: Controls hotspot navigation and the /hotspots page.

trips_enabled.label: My trips
trips_enabled.help: Controls trip navigation, save-trip actions, and pages under /trips. Read-only share links remain available.

alerts_enabled.label: Price alerts
alerts_enabled.help: Controls alert navigation, create-alert actions, and the /alerts page.

flight_status_enabled.label: Flight status
flight_status_enabled.help: Controls flight-status navigation and the /flights/status page.

airline_fares_enabled.label: Airline fare lab
airline_fares_enabled.help: Controls the airline-fares entry and the /labs/airlines page.

pricing_enabled.label: Plans & usage packs
pricing_enabled.help: Controls pricing navigation, usage-pack actions, and the /pricing page.

dashboard.title: Operations overview
dashboard.description: See what is published, what is waiting for review and how members stand, then open the module you need.

providers.title: APIs and providers
providers.description: Live flights, stays, activities, Google Maps and the Japanese routing services in one place; keys only ever reach the encrypted server-side store.

system.title: System settings
system.description: Open registration, provider run modes and the service's protective limits; a save applies to the very next request.

hotspots.title: Attraction review
hotspots.description: Attractions, place data, guides in five languages and nearby restaurant candidates: discover, approve, reject and retire them here.

users.title: Members and usage
users.description: Find members, manage accounts and admin rights, and add or deduct uses through an auditable ledger.

deployments.title: Deployment centre
deployments.description: Only the newest main that passed CI ships. A restricted host agent runs the backup, the migration, the health checks and the application rollback.

aiAccounts.title: AI settings
aiAccounts.description: Everything AI in one place: the subscription accounts the host's Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity use, and the API keys and models the site's AI features use.

videos.title: Video reviews
videos.description: Briefs, narration and finished videos from the video tool wait for your decision here: pick an outline, listen to the narration, watch the cut, and confirm it may be uploaded. Once the YouTube channel is linked, the site can send a video to it and schedule it; it still goes public only at the time you choose.

usersPanel.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
usersPanel.ledgerBalance: Ledger balance {count}; a deduction may not take it below the reserved amount.
usersPanel.adjustHint: Positive adds, negative deducts; the reason and who did it go into the ledger for good.

sitePages.confirmed: I have checked the content and operating details and confirm they can be published.

guides.confirmed: I have read this and confirm the action
guides.conflict: This article changed elsewhere. Reload before continuing.
guides.creditHelp: A photo needs its author, licence (for example CC BY-SA 4.0) and source page; a drawing of our own credits Mokaair.
guides.discard: There are unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
guides.error: That did not go through. Try again.
guides.heroHelp: The photo at the top of the article and on share cards: a jpg, png or webp under apps/web/public/guides/<slug>/, with its real pixel size.
guides.hiddenNotice: This article is hidden in every language. Restore it before publishing.
guides.hideHelp: Hiding takes every language of this article off the site, the lists and the sitemap immediately. Each language keeps its publication state and comes back when the article is restored.
guides.intro: Write, publish and withdraw first-party intel and guides. Each language publishes on its own; one you have not written is not shown.
guides.kindLocked: A published translation exists, so the article cannot move to another section. Unpublish every language first.
guides.lifeDestinationHelp: Lifestyle articles usually have no destination. Set one and the article ends with that city's full set of partner buttons, once the Lifestyle placement is enabled in catalog services.
guides.noTranslation: This article has no draft in this language yet.
guides.offerHelp: At most three per article. Which buttons show is decided by the catalog's approved destination offers; this only sets where and for which module.
guides.partnerHelp: Up to three per article. Only programs and hosts on the partner list are accepted; the article gets a disclosure line and the link is marked as sponsored. Paste the link from the affiliate program dashboard, not a customer referral code.
guides.partnerLinkPreview: Partner link (shown once published, while the partner is on the list)
guides.publishHelp: Publishing makes this language public immediately and adds it to the sitemap. Check the text and its sources first.
guides.restoreConfirm: Overwrite the current draft with this revision? Restoring does not change what is published.
guides.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, such as narita-to-tokyo. Every language shares one slug.
guides.tableHelp: The first line is the header; separate cells with | and put one row per line.
guides.title: Travel guides and lifestyle
guides.unhideHelp: Restoring puts every language that was published back on the site and in the sitemap immediately.
guides.unpublishHelp: Withdrawing takes this language off the site immediately. The URL stays and says the language is not available.
guides.validUntilHelp: For intel. Past this date the article leaves the listings and the sitemap; its URL stays.
guides.newsDateHelp: The day the news happened, not when the article was published or updated. The lifestyle hub and the news topic list news newest first by this date; leave it empty for anything that is not news.
guides.aliasesHelp: Names readers may type, comma-separated, up to 12
guides.relatedHelp: Article slugs, comma-separated, up to 4, in display order
guides.summaryHelp: One sentence per line, 2 to 5; placed before the first heading
guides.newTopicHelp: A new topic appears in this section's checkboxes at once, with no deploy. The slug is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique across the site; every language needs a name.

videoTools.title: Video tool tokens
videoTools.intro: The local video tool presents one of these tokens to have the server narrate with the key above. A token can only synthesize speech and can be revoked at any time; the server stores only its hash.
videoTools.createdTitle: This token is shown only once
videoTools.createdHelp: Pairing above is the usual way and needs no copying. A token made here is for where pairing is not possible (for example, paste it after running login --paste on your computer). It cannot be shown again after you leave this page.
videoTools.pairIntro: Run the video tool's login on your computer. It shows a code and a link to this page. Check that the code matches the one in your terminal, then choose Allow: the token goes straight to that computer, is never shown anywhere, and nothing needs copying.
videoTools.pairWarning: Only allow a code you just saw in your own terminal. If someone sent you a link asking you to allow it, deny it.
videoTools.pairApproved: Allowed. The video tool collects its token within a few seconds, and a paired token appears in the list.
videoTools.pairDenied: Denied. This code will not get a token.
videoTools.pairCodeInvalid: A code is 8 letters, such as BCDF-GHJK.
videoTools.pairFailed: This code could not be processed

videoReviews.emptyDetail: Videos appear here once the video tool submits them for review.
videoReviews.retryVideoHelp: After fixing the cause, ask the worker to try this video once more.
videoReviews.retryVideoPending: Retry requested. The worker will pick it up on its next run.
videoReviews.noPending: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
videoReviews.previewsGone: Published. The final mp4 leaves the review store 7 days after publishing; the thumbnail, captions and descriptions stay.
videoReviews.checkSummary: {lines} lines: {exact} word for word, {alike} differing only by same-sound characters or filler words, {judged} judged fine by Jev, {flagged} flagged.
videoReviews.metadata: Titles and descriptions in five languages
videoReviews.notePlaceholder: For example: the opening is too long; check the figures in chapter 3 again
videoReviews.dropDetail: Once dropped, the pipeline stops working on this video, and whatever waits for you and its previews are cleared. Its topic still counts as made, so later drafts will not pick it. This cannot be undone.
videoReviews.dropPlaceholder: For example: batch 2 already covers this topic
videoReviews.dropConfirm: Drop this video? This cannot be undone.
videoReviews.languagesHelp: Every video is made in Traditional Chinese. Tick what else it gets, per language: titles and descriptions, closed captions, a dub track. The worker makes only what is ticked and reports each part here; the video is scheduled once every ticked part is done. A dub track is timed with its captions, so ticking one ticks the other. "Tick the defaults" copies the settings tab's languages; "Traditional Chinese only" records that nothing else is wanted.
videoReviews.languagesLater: The languages can be chosen once the final cut is approved.
videoReviews.languagesAfterPublish: The video is on YouTube: what you tick now is made as a new batch and sent up. Unticking only holds for parts not on YouTube yet; what is already there you remove yourself in Studio.
videoReviews.dubDramaLater: Dubbing a drama comes later; for now a drama gets titles, descriptions and captions.
videoReviews.approveLanguages: Uploaded the dub tracks in Studio
videoReviews.studioTitle: The dub tracks go up in Studio
videoReviews.studioNote: Titles, descriptions and captions are sent through the API when the video is scheduled; only a dub track has to be uploaded by hand.
videoReviews.studioStep2: In YouTube Studio open Languages in the left menu, then this video, Add language, pick the language, Add next to Dubbing, choose the file, Publish; once per language.
videoReviews.studioStep3: Come back and press "Uploaded the dub tracks in Studio". Languages ticked later arrive as a new card.
videoReviews.scheduleWaits: It can go to YouTube once its languages are done: the upload package then carries them.
videoReviews.chooseLook: Choose the sheet every shot is drawn from
videoReviews.shotNeedsReview: No take passed the judge; the prompt needs a fix
videoReviews.newDramaHelp: Write the premise (or name a site article to adapt), pick a style and a length. It becomes a one-episode series: the worker writes its story bible for you to discuss and approve, then the screenplay; the episode's page holds the gates after that. The AI drama route must be on in the drama settings.
videoReviews.premisePlaceholder: Who wants what, what stands in the way, how it ends. A public-domain tale or an original story.
videoReviews.requestNotePlaceholder: e.g. a slower narrator, end on the next episode's title
videoReviews.cancelConfirm: Withdraw this request? The worker will not make it.
videoReviews.pickThresholds: Thresholds: stance and demonstration at least {min}, advice at most {max}.
videoReviews.pickBelow: Something is under a threshold, so it still waits for you.
videoReviews.mp4Retired: The final mp4 has been on YouTube for 7 days and was deleted from the review store; the thumbnail, captions and descriptions remain.
videoReviews.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically; the text is selected, press Ctrl+C.
videoReviews.uploadedHelp: In Studio upload only final.mp4 as private and fill in nothing else; paste the address here. The publish time is optional; the site fills in the rest and schedules it through the API.
videoReviews.youtubeUrlPlaceholder: https://youtu.be/…, watch?v=… or the Studio address
videoReviews.compilationInWorkspace: The cut is still in the worker's workspace

videoSettings.loadError: Could not load the video settings
videoSettings.readOnly: You can view these settings; changing them needs the manage settings permission.
videoSettings.enabledHelp: When on, the video worker on the production host finds topics and writes plans at the frequency below, then sends them to the Videos tab for you to choose an outline. When off, no new drafts are made and videos in progress stop at their current step.
videoSettings.onePerLine: One word or phrase per line.
videoSettings.modelsHelp: Claude Code and Codex use their signed-in subscription accounts on the host within each plan's limits. The API choices use the site's keys and are billed by use. A vendor marked "no key" needs its key entered first.
videoSettings.budgetHelp: When any limit is reached, the worker stops at its current step; it never switches to a cheaper model on its own. The monthly narration characters and daily Jev calls keep their settings under AI services.
videoSettings.gatesHelp: Uploading to YouTube and the publish time are always yours. The narration, the outline, the final cut and the upload confirmation each have a switch, and a gate switched off waits for you as before; a final cut that fails a check and an outline Jev cannot pick after two rewrites come back to you too.

videoSettings.subscriptionHelp: Claude Code and Codex subscription accounts rotate separately, A, B, C and back to A, when a usage window is full. When every account of the selected tool is full, the worker waits for a reset and never switches to an API key on its own.
videoSettings.modelsManaged: The model of each stage is chosen under AI settings › Models by feature.
videoSettings.dramaHelp: The drama route (docs/videos/DRAMA.md): AI-generated shots, a narrator plus character voices, burned-in subtitles and music. Switched off, the worker takes no drama requests and the media stages refuse to generate. The vendors use the site's Gemini and MiniMax keys; a vendor without a key is marked.
videoSettings.dramaBudgetHelp: Each month's budget stops generation at the server before a vendor is called; the per-video cap stops the tool before it submits. The owner chose to start without a cap (2026-09-26): the defaults are wide and are lowered after the pilot.
videoSettings.voicePoolHelp: Gemini voices the writer may give to characters; the narrator uses the voice above.
videoSettings.instructionsHelp: What you would otherwise repeat every time. The worker appends each stage's text to that stage's prompt on every tutorial; the drama's are on the Drama part. Up to 4,000 characters per field; empty means nothing is added.
videoSettings.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. narrate in Taiwanese colloquial Mandarin; end on the next episode's hook
videoSettings.promptsHelp: The full instructions the worker last sent to the model, the latest one per stage and format, with your standing instructions at the end. A stage appears after its first run. The fixed part lives in the repository's skill files (.agents/skills/youtube-video/references/prompts).
videoSettings.promptsEmpty: Nothing recorded yet: the first stage the worker runs will show up here.
videoSettings.stanceHelp: What this channel believes. The planner writes each video's owner viewpoint from this alone; the writer and Jev's checks read it too. It is separate from the standing instructions: those say how to write, this says what you believe. One numbered point per line, at most 4,000 characters. While it is blank Jev does not choose outlines and they wait for you as before. A draft is in docs/videos/HANDS-OFF.md under 頻道立場; edit it and paste it here. A change only reaches videos planned after it.
videoSettings.stancePlaceholder: e.g. 1. Count the cost before paying: pay for quota and abilities you will use, not to remove ads.
videoSettings.tutorialHelp: The tutorial videos: slides and the channel voice, planned from topics on a schedule. Each part of this tab saves on its own; the drama's settings are on the Drama part, what both use on Shared.
videoSettings.sharedHelp: What both kinds of video use: the channel stance, the topics to avoid, and the month's model token budget.
videoSettings.avoidElsewhere: Topics to avoid are on the Shared part.
videoSettings.avoidHelp: Both tutorials and dramas steer clear of these.
videoSettings.usageTokens: This month (UTC): {tokens} of {tokenBudget} API tokens used and {planTokens} tokens on the subscription accounts; {calls} model calls, {failed} of them failed.
videoSettings.localesHelp: Only what the language panel pre-ticks when a video's final cut is approved (docs/videos/LANGUAGES.md); nothing is made in another language until you save that panel.
videoSettings.dramaInstructionsHelp: Appended to each stage's prompt on every drama, one-off episodes and series episodes alike; the tutorials' are on the Tutorials part. Up to 4,000 characters per field; empty means nothing is added. A single episode's wishes go in the request's note or its discussion thread.
videoSettings.dramaModelsOwn: The drama runs its stages on these models, chosen under AI settings › Models by feature › Drama stages.
videoSettings.dramaModelsFollow: The drama's stages run on the tutorials' models. Give it its own under AI settings › Models by feature › Drama stages.
videoSettings.dramaModelsHelp: A drama's six stages (planning, writing, checking, listening, translating, caption review) may run on other models than a tutorial's. Tick "same as the tutorials" to keep the choices above.
videoSettings.dramaVoiceHelp: The drama's narrator: the channel voice, or one of its own. Characters speak with voices from the pool below.
videoSettings.seriesHelp: The pace of a long series (docs/videos/SERIES.md): how many episodes are in the making at once, when the next chapter is planned, and how many times a document is rewritten from your note before it waits for you.
videoSettings.dramaGatesHelp: Uploading to YouTube and the publish time are always yours. The screenplay waits for you unless you turn that off; the character sheets, the narration, the storyboard and the final cut each have a switch, and a switched-off gate waits for you as before.

videoSeries.newSeriesHelp: The premise in your words, the sides of the genre you care about, the tone and the shape. videoYoutube.title: YouTube channel
videoYoutube.help: Once linked, a video that is ready to upload can go straight to your channel: the site fills in the titles and descriptions in five languages, the tags, captions, thumbnail and publish time, and you only choose the time. The site never makes a video public itself; YouTube publishes it at the time you chose.
videoYoutube.loadError: Could not load the channel link: {message}
videoYoutube.readyToLink: The client is set up. Press "Link YouTube channel" and allow access on Google's screen.
videoYoutube.needsClient: First create an OAuth client in Google Cloud with the steps below, then paste its ID and secret here.
videoYoutube.stepsTitle: First-time setup: five steps in Google Cloud
videoYoutube.step1: In the Google Cloud Console, create (or pick) a project and enable YouTube Data API v3 under "APIs & Services → Library".
videoYoutube.step2: "OAuth consent screen": choose "External", name the app Mokaair Studio Sync (the name may not contain YouTube), then press "Publish app" to set the publishing status to "In production". In "Testing" the access expires after 7 days.
videoYoutube.step3: "Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID", type "Web application", and add this one under "Authorized redirect URIs":
videoYoutube.step4: Under "Data access" on the consent screen, add only this scope: {scope}
videoYoutube.step5: Paste the client ID and client secret below, save, then press "Link YouTube channel", choose the account (or brand account) that owns the channel on Google's screen and allow access. An unverified app first shows a warning: press "Advanced" → "Go to mokaair.com (unsafe)". As the only user, you are not affected.
videoYoutube.clientIdInvalid: This does not look like a web application client ID (it ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com)
videoYoutube.secretKept: Set; leave empty to keep it
videoYoutube.audited: The YouTube API audit has passed
videoYoutube.auditedHelp: Until it passes, YouTube locks videos the site uploads through the API as private and they cannot be made public, so an upload asks you once more. Tick this only after the audit approval arrives.
videoYoutube.verified: Access works; the channel details are up to date.
videoYoutube.unlinkConfirm: Unlinking asks Google to revoke the access, and videos can only be sent again after linking again. Continue?
videoYoutube.unlinkNotRevoked: The site has forgotten the access but could not tell Google; remove Mokaair Studio Sync under "Third-party apps & services" in your Google Account.
videoYoutube.revokeHelp: You can also revoke the access at any time in your Google Account → Security → "Third-party apps & services". The site checks every 25 days that the access still works.
videoYoutube.publishHelp: Sends to the channel "{channel}". Captions, thumbnail, the other languages' titles and descriptions, tags and disclosure come from the approved upload package; the Chinese title, description and visibility below are yours to decide.
videoYoutube.sourceStudio: I already uploaded it in Studio (private); paste the address
videoYoutube.lockWarning: The API audit has not passed: YouTube locks a video the site uploads as private, and it cannot be made public later. For a real release, choose "I already uploaded it in Studio" instead.
videoYoutube.lockAccept: I understand this one will be locked private (a test or a screenshot only)
videoYoutube.studioHelp: In Studio, just upload final.mp4 with the visibility set to "Private", leave every other field empty, then paste the address here.
videoYoutube.titleTooLong: The title can have at most {max} characters
videoYoutube.descriptionTooLong: The description can have at most {max} bytes
videoYoutube.angleBrackets: The title and description may not contain {characters} (YouTube refuses them)

visibilities.scheduled: Public at a chosen time (private until then)
visibilities.unlisted: Unlisted (anyone with the link can watch)

videoYoutube.neverPublic: The site never makes a video public directly: to publish, choose a time, and YouTube publishes it then.
videoYoutube.interruptedHelp: The site restarted in the middle of sending. Retry picks up where it stopped; steps already done are not repeated.
videoYoutube.linkHint: Once the YouTube channel is linked, the site can upload and fill in every field itself; you only choose the time.
videoYoutube.openSettings: Link it on the settings tab
videoYoutube.resendHelp: Change the title, description, visibility or publish time and the site rewrites the video's details; captions already there are not uploaded again. The site does not touch a video that is already public.

errors.generic: That did not go through. Please try again.
errors.authentication_required: Your session has expired. Sign in again, then link.
errors.video_youtube_unavailable: The site's service is unreachable right now. Please try again later.
errors.video_youtube_cancelled: You cancelled on Google's screen, so nothing was linked.
errors.video_youtube_state_invalid: The authorization timed out or did not start in this browser. Press link again.
errors.video_youtube_state_unavailable: The authorization cannot start right now. Please try again later.
errors.video_youtube_client_missing: Fill in and save the OAuth client ID and secret first.
errors.video_youtube_client_in_use: The channel is still linked through the old client: unlink first, then change the client.
errors.video_youtube_scope_missing: The YouTube permission was not ticked on Google's screen. Link again and tick it.
errors.video_youtube_no_refresh_token: Google gave no lasting access: remove Mokaair Studio Sync's access in your Google Account, then link again.
errors.video_youtube_no_channel: This Google account has no YouTube channel. When linking, choose the account or brand account that owns the channel.
errors.video_youtube_exchange_failed: Google refused this authorization: check the redirect URI and the client secret, then link again.
errors.video_youtube_unreachable: Google is unreachable. Please try again.
errors.video_youtube_verify_failed: YouTube did not accept this check. Please try again later.
errors.video_youtube_not_linked: No YouTube channel is linked yet: link one on the settings tab.
errors.video_youtube_grant_lost: The channel access no longer works. Link it again on the settings tab.
errors.video_youtube_sync_running: This video is being sent to YouTube. Wait for that run to finish.
errors.video_youtube_sync_missing: This video has not been sent to YouTube yet.
errors.video_youtube_sync_done: The last run finished every step; to change the details, send again.
errors.video_youtube_not_ready: This video has no approved upload package yet.
errors.video_youtube_package_invalid: The upload package does not match the approved one. Have the worker make the package again.
errors.video_youtube_package_missing: The upload package is no longer in the review store.
errors.video_youtube_text_invalid: The title or description breaks YouTube's rules (length, or angle brackets).
errors.video_youtube_publish_at_missing: "Public at a chosen time" needs a publish time.
errors.video_youtube_publish_at_past: The publish time must be at least five minutes from now.
errors.video_youtube_url_invalid: No video id in this: paste a youtu.be, watch?v=, shorts or Studio address.
errors.video_youtube_already_uploaded: This video is already on YouTube; to change its details, use "Send to YouTube again".
errors.video_youtube_mp4_missing: The review store no longer has this video's mp4. Upload it in Studio.
errors.video_youtube_private_lock: The API audit has not passed: to upload anyway, tick "I understand this one will be locked private".
